description: Simulate disruption cascades across AI compute supply chain. Model what happens downstream when a specific chokepoint fails — e.g. TSMC fab disruption, ASML equipment embargo, rare earth export ban, Taiwan Strait closure, major data center power outage. Returns cascade sequence (which suppliers/sectors are affected and in what order), time-to-impact per tier, cost impact estimates, and recommended procurement hedges. Use for supply chain stress testing and procurement contingency planning.

shock.description: The disruption to model. Examples: 'TSMC N3 fab offline 60 days', 'ASML EUV embargo expanded', 'Taiwan Strait closure', 'CoWoS packaging capacity -40%', 'rare earth export quota cut 30%'

name: compute.cascade
